ES:
{{TAG:000C:0001:}}{{TAG:000C:0004:}}{{TAG:000C:0002:}}{{TAG:000C:0006:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}¡Vaya!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Habéis tardado lo vuestro
en venir, ¿eh?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¡Ya estaba a punto de enviar
un equipo de búsqueda a por
vosotros, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
IT:
{{TAG:000C:0001:}}{{TAG:000C:0004:}}{{TAG:000C:0002:}}{{TAG:000C:0006:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Uau!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ce n'è voluto di tempo
per farvi arrivare qui!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Stavo per organizzare
una spedizione per venirvi
a cercare! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}{{TAG:000C:0009:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Esto{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ya sé que ha pasado mucho
tiempo, pero tengo que devolverte
esta cosa que me habías prestado.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Gracias por no haberte enfadado
conmigo en todo este tiempo,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
IT:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Ehm{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Sono un po' in ritardo, ma
devo ridarti questa cosa che ti
avevo chiesto in prestito tempo fa.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Grazie per la pazienza che hai
avuto, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Şey{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Çok gecikti ama bir süre
önce ödünç aldığım şeyi geri vermem gerek.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Bunca zamandır anlayışla karşıladığın
için sağ ol, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:000C:0009:}}

EN:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I found something for you!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Here's a
hint:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} the other day, we talked about
how you've wanted one for a while.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}So here you go!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
ES:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡He encontrado algo para ti!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ahí va
una pista:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} el otro día me dijiste
que te hacía mucha falta.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}¡Así que aquí está!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
IT:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ho trovato una cosa per te!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ecco
un indizio:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} l'altro giorno mi avevi
detto che la volevi da tanto.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Quindi l'ho presa!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
DE:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ich hab hier was für dich!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ein Tipp:
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Du hast mir erst neulich erzählt,
dass du schon lange danach suchst!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Und ich hab's gefunden!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Hier, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}bitte!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Senin için bir şey buldum!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} İpucu
vereyim:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} geçen gün uzun zamandır
bir tane istediğinden konuşmuştuk.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Al bakalım!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}

EN:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}I was on my way to my power-
tetherball class the other day,
and I found something.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}It smells expensive and snobby, so I
figured it must be yours.{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
ES:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}El otro día iba a mi clase de balón
prisionero extremo cuando me
encontré una cosa.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Tenía un olor a colonia cara y
pijilla, así que pensé que
debía de ser algo tuyo.{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
FR:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}Je suis tombé sur ce machin l'autre
jour, en me rendant à mon cours de
spiroballe en apesanteur{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Vu qu'il cocotte à deux kilomètres,
je me suis dit qu'il devait
t'appartenir...{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
IT:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}Mentre andavo al corso
di pallacanestro avanzato,
ho trovato una cosa.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Mi è sembrato un oggetto
costoso e da vero snob, quindi
ho pensato subito a te.{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}Geçen gün güç tetherball dersime
giderken bir şey buldum.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Pahalı ve biraz ukala kokuyor, senindir
diye düşündüm.{{TAG:000C:0009:}}

EN:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Yo, you know how you tend to use
a lot of big, important words?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Well{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}will you teach me some? {{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}I think they'd be useful when I play
sports!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I feel like a big word here or
there could help out, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
ES:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Oye, tú siempre hablas con unas
expresiones muy modernas que
demuestran que has leído mucho...
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Una preguntita{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿No me podrías
enseñar algunas?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}¡Es que son muy útiles en el
deporte!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ¡Es esencial que el rival
sienta inferioridad, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
FR:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}C'est au sujet de ces mots un peu
tordus que tu es le seul à utiliser...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Comment dire{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} tu voudrais bien
m'en apprendre quelques-uns ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Je pourrais m'en servir en compète,
pour déstabiliser l'adversaire ou me
motiver...{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
IT:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ehilà, ti ho sentito usare un sacco
di volte parole che suonano
difficili e importanti...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Non è che{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} me ne puoi insegnare
qualcuna?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Penso che potrebbero essermi utili
quando faccio sport!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Qualcosa da
dire ogni tanto, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}

FR:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Je vois.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Mon charisme sans bornes a
fait une victime de plus...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Hé hé !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} J'en suis honoré.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}Mais pas
franchement surpris.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ceci dit,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ma façon de parler repose
principalement sur un savant dosage
entre stylitude et sophistitude.
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Ce qui me paraît incompatible avec
des concepts tels que la sueur ou
l'excès de testostérone{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Autrement dit, pour utiliser des
mots que tu comprends :{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} c'est non.
DE:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Du bist also beeindruckt von meiner
Art, mit Worten umzugehen?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Hahaha!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich fühle mich geehrt.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Diese Fähigkeit erlangt man aber
nicht, indem man Fitnesstraining
macht wie ein Wahnsinniger.
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Wenn du so werden willst wie ich,
musst du nicht nur körperlich,
sondern auch geistig topfit sein! 
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Ich glaube aber nicht, dass du mit
großen Worten deinen sportlichen
Zielen näher kommst...

ES:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Seguro que ya sabías que se
acercaba este día!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Te crees el
mejor, ¡y por eso voy a retarte!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡A ver quién puede más! ¡Vamos
a echar un pulso de pulgares
a muerte!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
FR:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu devais t'y attendre, non ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Toi qui
est censé être le meilleur, je ne dois
pas être le premier à te défier !
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Mais passons aux choses sérieuses !
Montre-moi cette main toujours
invaincue à la bataille de pouces !{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
IT:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sapevi che questo giorno sarebbe
arrivato!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Dicono che sei il migliore
e io voglio sfidarti!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Forza! Fammi vedere la tua mano
leggendaria! Conosciuta da tutti
i campioni di lotta dei pollici!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
DE:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0005:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Du kannst dir denken, warum du hier
bist. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Ich will wissen, ob hinter deiner
großen Klappe auch was steckt!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ich will wissen, ob du wirklich der
beste Daumenwrestler in unserer
Stadt bist!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}

EN:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Sorry, but I'm not going to thumb
wrestle with you, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Too many friendships have already
suffered at the hand of my{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}thumb!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Having this much power is a curse!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I've sworn to only use my talent for
good.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} My competitive days are over.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Instead of battling, I'm going to use
my legendary left thumb to pick you
some flowers of friendship!
ES:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}Esto{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}} Lo siento,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} pero no pienso
someter mis pulgares a ningún
tipo de violencia, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Mis pulgares solo actúan en defensa
propia{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡y son implacables!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Un gran pulgar conlleva una gran
responsabilidad{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} y juré usar los míos
para defender a los más débiles.
Hace tiempo que dejé atrás las
competiciones profesionales. ¡Ahora
solo los uso para pasar páginas!
FR:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Désolé{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} mais ça va pas être
possible,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Trop d'amitiés ont été détruites
par les mains de mon{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} pouce !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ce
doigt est une véritable malédiction !
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}J'ai donc raccroché, préférant être
idolâtré pour ma classe naturelle
plutôt que pour cet invincible pouce.
IT:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}} Scusami, ma non mi va
di combattere contro di te nella
lotta dei pollici, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Troppe amicizie si sono rotte
a causa del mio{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} pollice!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Avere
tanta forza è una maledizione!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ho giurato di usare il mio talento
solo per fare del bene.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ormai
sono fuori dalle competizioni.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Invece di combattere, userò il mio
pollice leggendario per regalarti
dei fiori in segno di amicizia!
DE:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Tut mir leid, aber ich habe meinen
Daumen schon vor langer Zeit an
den Nagel gehängt, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Zu viele Freundschaften sind unter
der Macht dieses Daumens zu Bruch
gegangen...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich habe mir geschworen, meine
Fähigkeiten nur noch im Notfall
einzusetzen.
Aber ich könnte dir mit meinem
legendären Daumen stattdessen
ein paar Blumen pflücken!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:000C:0000:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Üzgünüm ama seninle başparmak güreşi
yapmayacağım, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Bu{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}başparmağım
yüzünden zaten çok fazla dostluk
zarar gördü!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Bu kadar güç sahibi olmak bir lanet!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yeteneğimi yalnızca iyilik
için kullanmaya yemin ettim.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Rekabet günlerim
bitti.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Savaşmak yerine efsanevi sol
başparmağımla sana dostluk
çiçekleri toplayacağım!

ES:
Bueno, parece que eso era todo.
Ya va siendo hora de que me
marche, que se me hace tarde...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:000C:0002:}}{{TAG:000C:0004:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} gracias por tu ayuda.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
¡Hasta otra, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
Ich mach mich dann mal wieder
auf den Weg.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:000C:0002:}}{{TAG:000C:0004:}}Danke, dass du mich hergebracht
hast, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bis demnächst,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
And with that, I think I'll take my
leave.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}If I stick around, I'll never stop
talking!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}} See you later!
ES:
Con esto concluye mi misión aquí.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} 
Espero que el resultado haya sido
satisfactorio, mis comandantes.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Bah, menos mal que ya ha acabado
el ciclo de cine bélico.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Al final acabo
hablando como un sargento.{{TAG:0003:0020:}} ¡Adiós!
FR:
Sur ce, je file.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Un jour, vous
comprendrez peut-être tout ce
qu'implique la vie de célébrité...
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Ciao.
IT:
E con questa, il mio tempo qui
è scaduto.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mi pare che abbiamo
risolto un po' di cose.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ma se rimango ancora qui, potrei
non smettere più di parlare!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}}
Ci vediamo!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ich könnte mich noch ewig mit euch
beiden unterhalten, aber ich bin ein
viel beschäftigter Mann.
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Wir sehen uns!
TRANSLATION:
Bununla birlikte ben artık müsaadenizi
isteyeyim.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Burada kalırsam konuşmayı hiç
bırakamam!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}} Sonra görüşürüz!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}OK, je crois que j'ai ma dose de
beaufitude pour aujourd'hui,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:000C:0002:}}{{TAG:000C:0004:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} sympa d'avoir joué les
taxis.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} À pied, certes, mais tout de
même.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0020:}}Bye.
DE:
Also gut, ich mach mich dann mal
wieder auf den Heimweg.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:000C:0002:}}{{TAG:000C:0004:}}Danke, dass du dieses Treffen
möglich gemacht hast, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Mach's gut, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
